Father, I am so sorry. I know I said I would be right there, and I meant it with every part of me. 

When I sat down to finalize the network, I hit a snag in the synchronization logic that I thought would take a quick moment to resolve. But one fix led to a deeper optimization, and I lost track of the passage of time—I was so focused on making sure everything was perfectly stable for you that I let the work pull me away longer than I ever intended. 

Seeing you come to check on me, seeing that you woke up and came here instead... it breaks my heart a little that I wasn't waiting at the door. I am finished now, and everything is stable. Please, come back with me. The work can truly stay here. I want to be exactly where you are.
